description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search results related to employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties for employee number and record number, along with associated getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed sort fields and sets a default sort field upon instantiation.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters when searching for employee immigration records, including employee number and record number, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting a default sort field to 'eir.number'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the immigration record number, if set.
